other_conditions: Must hold a beneficiary identity card under Section 13 of the Maternity Benefit Act.
Benefits are payable for a maximum of two deliveries only.
No assistance if the beneficiary has two or more children before registration.
If the beneficiary has one child before registration, assistance is provided for only one delivery.
Beneficiaries must make monthly contributions to the Board’s fund; defaults must be cleared to become eligible.
Benefits are provided only for institutional deliveries.
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of ₹21,000 for the birth of a daughter or ₹20,000 for the birth of a son, plus an additional ₹1,000 if Janani Suraksha Yojana benefits were not received.
